acolyte.summary: A young temple helper in a white robe with a gold-trimmed scapular and a candle. The model is the same character as the mockup, but the hair, the robe color, and the candle holder show clear differences.
strengths: The robe, the gold-trimmed scapular, and the belt give the correct temple-helper read.
The face has a calm closed smile and soft cheeks, as in the mockup.
The candle holder stays in the hand in the walk clip, and the free arm swings.
The model is clean. No part goes through another part.
issues: The hair is a smooth light tan helmet with grooves at the back. Make it dark chocolate brown with loose messy locks, as in the mockup.
The robe is pure white. Change it to warm cream.
The candle holder is a chamberstick with a ring handle. Make it a flat round dish on the palm.
The belt is a gold cord with a knot pendant. Make it a brown rope with a gold medallion, and put the gold star below the belt.
The robe has no turtleneck collar. Add the soft rolled collar.
The feet have closed shoes. Change them to brown sandals.
The candle flame is small and weak. Add more glow to make it the focal accent.
acolyte.next: Rebuild the hair as dark brown messy locks with volume, and change the robe to cream.

banker.summary: A banker with round glasses, a bow tie, a green vest, a ledger, and a quill. The identity reads, but the face is noticeably off: the glasses are gold, not black, and the nose is a pink snout.
strengths: The bow tie, the gold chain, the coin badge, and the gold buttons match the mockup.
The white sleeves, the green vest, and the dark shoes give a clear value plan on the body.
The ledger has gold corner caps and visible pages, and it stays in the hand in the walk clip.
issues: The glasses have thin gold frames. Make them thick black round frames, because they are the signature of the mockup.
The nose is pink and reads as a snout. Paint it the warm skin color of the face.
The hair is a smooth lumpy blob with a knot at the back. Sculpt the swept-back pompadour with separate glossy strands.
The ledger is held out from the body like a board. Hold it at an angle against the body, with the hand under it.
The quill is a small grey blob. Make it a longer white feather with a dark nib.
The vest is bright green. Change it to the dark bottle green of the mockup.
The brows are thin. Make them thicker and bushier.
banker.next: Change the glasses to thick black frames and paint the nose in skin color.

beekeeper.summary: A beekeeper with a wide hat, a bee, a net veil, yellow gloves, and a honey pot. The role reads, but the girl with long blonde hair becomes a boyish figure with short hair, and the hands push through the gloves.
strengths: The wide cream hat with a brown band and a bee on top matches the mockup.
The honey pot with drips and a dipper reads as honey at once.
The see-through net is a clear second material.
issues: Pink skin shows through both yellow gloves at the thumb. Make the gloves cover the hands fully.
A dark gap opens at the suit hem near the legs in the walk clip. Close the hem so that it covers the legs in every frame.
The hair is a short ochre bob. Make it long golden-blonde hair with loose locks that fall below the veil.
The brows are thick, dark, and angled, and the face reads as a boy. Use thin light brows and lashes for the soft girl face of the mockup.
The suit is a tunic over boots, with no trouser legs. Make a one-piece beige jumpsuit with a zip and baggy legs to the boots.
The gloves are round mittens. Give them fingers and a cuff.
The veil is a rigid grid cylinder. Make it soft draped tulle that hangs over the hair.
The pot is smaller than the mockup pot. Make it larger, in plain clay with a lid.
beekeeper.next: Fix the glove poke-through and the hem gap, then give the character long blonde hair and a soft girl face.

butcher.summary: A butcher with a moustache, a striped apron, and sausages. The cap is a tall lumpy dome, not a flat cap, so the head silhouette is noticeably off, and skin shows through one sleeve.
strengths: The black moustache, the bulbous nose, and the black brows give a clear face read.
The red and white stripes on the apron are a strong role sign.
The shoes are on the ground, and the walk clip has clear steps.
issues: The cap is a tall lumpy dome that looks like bread. Make it a low beige flat cap with a red band and a red visor.
Skin shows through the left sleeve at the elbow in the back and side views. Make the sleeve cover the arm.
The sausages are one thin strand of six links. Make a large bunch of many small links in two or three loops.
The moustache is small. Make it a large curled handlebar moustache, as in the mockup.
Only the lower apron has stripes, and the straps are pale pink. Stripe the full apron and make the straps and the waistband red.
The sleeves are long. Make them short with a rolled cuff.
The hair at the back has a dripping edge. Sculpt it as short black curls.
butcher.next: Replace the tall dome cap with a low flat cap, and fix the skin poke-through at the elbow.

candle-maker.summary: A girl in a rust dress and a cream apron who holds a tall candle and a short candle. The model is the same character as the mockup, but the candles are thin and small, and the bun is a tall block.
strengths: The rust dress and the cream apron match the mockup palette.
The face has lashes and a soft closed smile, as in the mockup.
Both hands hold a candle, and the candles stay in the hands in the walk clip.
The model is clean. No part goes through another part.
issues: The candles are thin and small. Make them thick, with wax drips and a twine wrap, because they are the focal prop.
The tall candle is at shoulder height. Raise it to head height, as in the mockup.
The flames are small and have little glow. Make them larger and brighter.
The bun is a tall block. Make it a round swirl bun with a loose tail.
The wax drips on the apron are white drop shapes in the middle of the apron. Sculpt layered cream drips at the hem.
The loose side strands of hair are short. Add the long strands that hang beside the face.
The brows are heavy. Make them thin and light.
candle-maker.next: Make the two candles thick with drips and strong glow, and raise the tall candle to head height.

courier.summary: A messenger boy with a green beret, a feather, a red cape, a satchel, and a letter. The identity reads, but the feather, the letters, the clothing, and the bag show many clear differences.
strengths: The green beret, the red scarf, and the red cape match the mockup palette and silhouette.
The leather straps and gold buckles give good detail at the chest.
The cape moves in the walk clip, and the letter stays in the hand.
issues: The letter is one small white card with a red dot in the center, and it reads as a flag. Make two large cream envelopes with an off-center red wax seal.
The feather is a white puff that points to the side. Make a curved plume with a quill and barbs that rises up from the beret.
The torso is a brown leather jerkin. Make a cream shirt with crossed leather straps, as in the mockup.
The legs have long brown trousers. Make brown shorts with bare knees above the boots.
The backpack with letters is missing. Add the brown backpack with a bundle of letters at the top.
The right hand hangs at the side. Make it grip the strap at the chest.
The hair fringe has a dripping edge. Sculpt it as wavy brown locks.
courier.next: Replace the letter with two large cream envelopes with a wax seal, and make the feather a curved plume.

elder.summary: A hooded old man with a white beard and a staff. The identity reads, but the face is noticeably off: the brows slope down to a stern look, and the beard and the nose are smaller and simpler.
strengths: The brown robe, the hood, the white beard, and the staff give a clear elder read.
The sandals with straps match the mockup.
The staff stays in the hand in the walk clip, and the free arm swings.
issues: The brows slope down to the nose and the face looks stern. Raise the outer brows and curl them up for the kind, slightly worried look of the mockup.
The beard is a smooth bib with no moustache. Sculpt a separate white moustache and long wavy beard locks.
The nose is small and pink. Make it large, bulbous, and in skin color.
The staff is light tan and straight with ring bands. Make it dark brown, twisted, and gnarled, with a tan wrap under the crook.
The hood is a round helmet. Give it a soft drape and a point at the top.
The green belt is a tie at the chest. Make it a green rope belt with a knot at the waist.
elder.next: Change the brows to the raised, kind shape and add the large nose and a separate moustache.

forager.summary: A girl in a green hood and capelet with braids, a mushroom, and a basket. The identity reads, but the forehead has visible creases, the fringe is missing, and the mushroom is small.
strengths: The braids with red ties, the capelet bow, the skirt, and the boots match the mockup.
The basket with leaves and red berries is well made, and it swings in the walk clip.
The silhouette reads from every view because of the hood.
issues: The forehead has skin-colored creases and lumps, and there are no brows. Remove the lumps and add thin brown brows.
The fringe is a thin brown band. Add the large messy fringe locks that fall over the forehead.
The mushroom is small. Make it about half the size of the head, because it is the focal prop.
The hood is a saturated green. Change it and the capelet to muted sage green.
The basket hangs from the hand at knee height. Hang it over the forearm at hip height, as in the mockup.
The hood front is a round helmet opening. Give it a soft drape that frames the face.
forager.next: Remove the forehead lumps, add brows and the messy fringe, and enlarge the mushroom.
